common_gotchas: Select DAT references another DAT; it does not copy data into an independent static table.
Row/column selection modes change which Start/End/Values/Expression parameters matter.
Include First Row/Col can keep headers even when the selected range would otherwise exclude them.
Expression selection evaluates conditions against the configured source row or column.
Use a Null DAT after Select DAT when downstream consumers need a stable output path.
Avoid selecting by index when source table layouts may reorder; names or headers are safer.
key_concepts: Fetches a DAT from another project location and optionally extracts table subsets.
Row and column extract modes support all, name range, index range, explicit values, and expression conditions.
From Column and From Row choose the comparison source for value-based selections.
Output mode can pass data through, evaluate strings, or evaluate expressions.
